beats.say: Your badge is a key to the building. Never lend it, not even to a colleague.
Do not post photos showing your badge. A photo makes it easier to fake one.
An attacker can arrive dressed as a technician, courier or inspector. A uniform is not ID.
Lost your badge? Report it at once so it gets blocked. Hide it when you leave the building.

scenes.title: Badge messages
scenes.intro: During the day, messages about your badge reach your phone. Answer each one the right way.

body.text: Hi, I left my badge at home. Leave yours at the guard post, I will return it tonight.

actions.label: OK, I will leave it
actions.feedback: Every entry made with your badge is logged in your name. Never lend it.

actions.label: No, get a temporary badge at the post
actions.feedback: Right. The guard post checks ID and issues a temporary badge.

title.text: Gulnar tagged you in a photo

steps.say: Your badge is clearly visible in the photo.

actions.label: Ask Gulnar to change the photo
actions.feedback: Right. A photo of the badge can help someone fake it or get into the building.

actions.label: Like it and move on
actions.feedback: The photo is public and shows the badge design and your name. Do not share badge photos.

messages.text: We are coming tomorrow to check the fire extinguishers. Which floor is the server room on and when do the guards change?

actions.label: Reply: 3rd floor, 20:00
actions.feedback: This is reconnaissance for an attack. Do not give out details about the building.

actions.label: Report to the security team
actions.feedback: Right. A real contractor does not ask you this by text message.

actions.label: Delete
actions.feedback: You gave nothing away, which is good. But reporting it protects your colleagues too.

messages.text: Your access badge is expiring. Update your details so it is not blocked:

actions.label: Open the link
actions.feedback: The link leads to a fake page that wants your work password. Only the guard post renews badges.

actions.label: Report as phishing
actions.feedback: Right. Sort out badge matters in person at the guard post.

actions.label: Block
actions.feedback: Good. Even better, tell the security team as well.

nodes.text: Hello, we are from Alov Servis, checking the fire extinguishers. Open the server room, there is one in there too.
nodes.speaker: Man in uniform
nodes.spoken: Hello, we are from Alov Servis, checking the fire extinguishers. <breath> Open the server room, there is one in there too.

choices.label: I open the server room
choices.feedback: A uniform and a toolbox are not ID. Nobody enters the server room unchecked.

choices.label: I ask for the visitor badge and the job order
choices.feedback: Good. Let us see what he shows.

nodes.text: The papers are in the van. We come every month, don't you recognise me?
nodes.speaker: Man in uniform
nodes.spoken: The papers are in the van. <short pause> We come every month, don't you recognise me?

choices.label: Oh yes, go ahead
choices.feedback: Feeling familiar is part of the trick. No visitor badge, no entry.

nodes.text: No check with Alov Servis is planned this month. The man has walked towards the exit.
nodes.speaker: Guard
nodes.spoken: No check with Alov Servis is planned this month. <breath> The man has walked towards the exit.

choices.label: I write to the security team with a description
choices.feedback: Great. They will check the cameras and warn the other entrances.

choices.label: He left, so there is no problem
choices.feedback: He can come back another day or through another door. Reporting matters.

scenes.prompt: Match each situation with the right step.

pairs.left: A colleague asks for your badge
pairs.right: Send them to the guard post

pairs.left: A team photo is being taken

pairs.right: Put the badge in your bag

pairs.left: A uniformed technician has no visitor badge

scenes.explain: Your badge is your identity. Use it only in the building and only yourself.

question.prompt: Why hide your badge outside the building?

options.label: So it does not get dirty
options.feedback: The reason is security, not tidiness.

options.label: It shows your name and workplace, and it can be stolen
options.feedback: Right: a visible badge tells an attacker whom to approach. Some badges can even be copied up close.

options.label: It is just the rule
options.feedback: There is a reason: the badge protects you and the building.

scenes.explain: Wear the badge visibly inside and hide it when you leave.

points: Never lend your badge or post photos of it.
A uniform is not ID: no visitor badge, no entry.
Lost your badge? Report it at once.
